description: This file defines types, functions, and classes related to ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) snapshot parsing and comparison, including ARIA roles, properties, nodes, and YAML parsing utilities.

classes.name: KeyParser
classes.description: Parser class for interpreting role and attribute keys in ARIA YAML templates.

classes.name: ParserError
classes.description: Custom error class for syntax errors during ARIA key parsing.

methods.name: ariaNodesEqual
methods.description: Compares two AriaNode objects for equality based on role, name, properties, and cursor.

methods.name: hasPointerCursor
methods.description: Checks if an AriaNode's box has a cursor style of 'pointer'.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshotUnsafe
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML string into an AriaTemplateNode, throwing on errors.

methods.name: parseAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Parses an ARIA snapshot YAML string into an AriaTemplateNode, returning errors if any.

methods.name: findNewNode
methods.description: Finds a new AriaNode in the target that is not present in the source node, based on role and name.
